adjudication.rationale: In TopicEmbed.import, `url` is only gated by `return unless url =~ /^https?\:\/\//` and is then interpolated directly into HTML: `"#{url}"` (app/models/topic_embed.rb). Because posts created here use `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and Post#cook returns `raw` unchanged for `:raw_html`, this HTML is stored and later rendered unsanitized (e.g., app/views/embed/best.html.erb uses `raw post.cooked`). Since `'` is valid in a URL, a value like `http://eviltrout.com/x'onmouseover='alert(1)` can break out of the single-quoted href attribute and inject arbitrary attributes/HTML, leading to stored XSS. Host checks in TopicRetriever don't prevent this because the malicious URL can still have the allowed host.
